exposure: Mode of conception (donor oocyte IVF, autologous oocyte IVF, natural conception)
cohort: Women aged 45-47 years who gave birth to singletons at a tertiary medical centre between March 2011 and May 2018, at 24 weeks' gestation or later
finding: IVF pregnancies in the late fifth decade of life were associated with significantly higher rates of gestational hypertensive disorders compared with naturally conceived pregnancies.
mod_finding: The rate of Caesarean deliveries was significantly higher in the IVF-OD and IVF-A groups compared with the natural conception group.
